title: figlab error codes
description: The list of error codes of the command language (docs/language.md Section 8).

errors.description: Sorted by code. A code keeps its meaning once it is published. Codes are never reused.

code.description: E1xxx lexical and line, E2xxx syntax, E3xxx names, E4xxx types and arguments, E5xxx runtime.

name.description: A stable identifier for code, in snake_case.

message.description: The message after the code, in English, starting with a lowercase letter. Words in braces, such as {name}, are filled in.

at.description: Where the error points (docs/language.md 8). Required for E1xxx and E2xxx, which the conformance tests check by position.

doc.description: A longer explanation for the help and the reference.

section.description: Where the rule is defined, for example "language.md 2.1".
